tagline: The ROM and the save live in this file. Invite is player two.
description:
jsnes.org fetches its sample carts from the network. This copy keeps the cartridges inside the GIF, so you can close it, come back, or hand the file to someone, and the same games are still in there.

Two homebrew carts ride along — Concentration Room (two of you at the table) and Lawn Mower (cut the grass before the tank runs dry). Neither has a battery chip; close and reopen still lands you where you were, because a savestate lives in this file. Drop a .nes dump that does have a battery, and that RAM is kept too. Nothing Nintendo ships in this file.

Send the invite. You stay player one; they are player two, on their phone or their computer, no account. On a phone the pad is under your thumbs — d-pad, A, B, and Select/Start above them so Start is a thumb target.

An unofficial port of JSNES by Ben Firshman, Apache-2.0. The engine is theirs. The save in the icon, the second controller on a second device, and the thumb pad are this copy.
